comparison.objective: Seat a swing-top bottle stopper and push its lever through an over-centre toggle while steadying the bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bracing, hinged-part sequencing, and force through a resistance peak; no hammer-mediated fracture or fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Lever past centre with stopper within 5 degrees of seat; bottle upright under 10 degrees, grippers at least 3 cm clear for 2 s; any 30-degree tip zeros the run.
comparison.reason: Both regulate transient force while the other hand stabilizes something, but the bottle task tests over-centre latching of retained parts, not impact fracture and debris containment.
